pages.wizard.banner_done_message: ResearchOS opened the workspace. The shell and your projects are available now.
pages.wizard.bullet_1: Choose a folder. An empty folder is initialized; an existing workspace is opened as it is.
pages.wizard.bullet_2: ResearchOS writes its databases and libraries only inside that folder.
pages.wizard.bullet_3: Nothing outside the folder is created or moved.
pages.wizard.description: A workspace holds your databases, papers, projects and exports in one folder.
pages.wizard.err_picker_unavailable: The system folder picker is unavailable; type the path instead.
pages.wizard.field_path_desc: Pick a folder with the system dialog, or type its path and validate it.
pages.wizard.guidance_foreign: ResearchOS never initializes into a non-empty folder. Choose an empty folder or an existing workspace.
pages.wizard.guidance_marker_corrupt: The .researchos marker cannot be read. Restore it from a backup, or choose another workspace.
pages.wizard.guidance_marker_missing: The folder contains a global database but its .researchos marker is gone. Restore the marker from a backup, or choose the folder that holds the complete workspace.
pages.wizard.title: Set up ResearchOS
